title: Yonah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Chullin 43b, “Yonah, Zeira said: mevala’ta (מבלעתא).” Hyman reports that the Constantinople printing of the Rif has “R. Yonah אר״ז,” as cited in Dikdukei Soferim. He also reports that the halakhic authorities understood yonah as an actual dove rather than a sage’s name.

notes.text: The notice contrasts a personal name Yonah with yonah, “dove.” The consulted Chullin text and Rashi describe the swallowing passage; the Constantinople Rif reading remains Hyman’s report, not a new examination of that printing.

The Bavli passage gives the wording involving yonah and Zeira, and Rashi explains the swallowing place. The Constantinople Rif reading and the halakhic authorities’ interpretation are given as reported by Hyman.
